quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: Feel for a buzz against the roof of your mouth: 'zip' should hum, 'sip' should just hiss.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "zip." The /z/ is voiced, buzzing as the air passes. "Sip" would use the voiceless /s/, just a quiet hiss.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /s/ and /z/ use the same tongue position. /s/ is a voiceless hiss; /z/ adds a voiced buzz on top of it.
